Name: Renew and deploy SSL and internal CA certificates
Description: Owner: Ben. Deadline: August 22nd. Renew the wildcard SSL cert for api.ourapp.com (expires September 1st) and deploy it to the load balancers. Also rotate the internal CA cert that signs the service mesh, which expires two weeks after the public cert. Both certs should be handled in the same change window. Set up cert-manager for both certificates so they auto-renew going forward, eliminating the need for annual manual renewals.
